observations: SheenBidi unity C source is part of CRISPEMBED_SOURCES before static and shared targets.
iOS packaging flattens libcrispembed-static.a into libcrispembed.a alongside the existing core/ggml archives.
Android builds the same C source into libcrispembed.so with static ggml; no additional SheenBidi shared library is required.

The prior mobile builder bypassed CMake install, so native license/notice files were omitted. The accompanying builder now copies and hashes committed notices and verifies defined renderer dependency symbols; the app receipt checks actual packaged notice bytes.
execution_status: Static source inspection and helper rejection controls only. No final native artifact or target execution is qualified by this audit.
